name: Liraz Siri
description: Liraz Siri is a builder, cybersecurity researcher and partner at the Ethereum Ecosystem Fund. He co-founded TurnKey Linux, an open source project that made Linux servers easy to deploy, and later helped pioneer gasless transactions on Ethereum through the Gas Station Network, work that helped pave the way for ERC-4337 account abstraction. His focus is privacy, open source software and systems that reduce reliance on intermediaries. He is currently exploring how Ethereum can support sovereign AI.
